description: KDE Plasma desktop on Ubuntu Resolute (25.10) with Wayland. Kasm's official KDE core image (the only Kasm-native KDE option currently published). Only the develop channel is available.
notes: kasmweb/core-ubuntu-resolute-wkde is a Kasm core image - it ships KasmVNC and a working KDE Plasma session, but no preinstalled apps. Brand new (April 2026) and only published with the develop tag.
